50238821.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to His6-tagged BRD2 (1 to 473 aa) (unknown origin) by SPR method

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface Plasmon Resonance (Biacore) Analysis of Binding to BRD2, 3, and 4. His6-tagged BRD2 (1–473), BRD3 (1–434), and BRD4 (1–477) was acquired and analyzed on a T100 Biacore instrument at 25 °C. In all cases, a CM5 chip with ~5–12kU amine coupled protein immobilized on the dextran surface was used with a running buffer of 30 mM Heps pH 7, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM EGTA, Na3. Compounds were titrated as a tripling dilution starting from 10 μM. Sensorgrams and binding curves were analyzed with BIAevaluation (GE Healthcare) using a 1:1 binding model. The equilibrium K_D was calculated using response = concentration × R_max/(concentration + K_D) + offset. Example dose response fits are given in Supporting Information, Figure S2.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 30 mM Heps pH 7, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM EGTA, Na3

50238823.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to His6-tagged BRD4 (1 to 477 aa) (unknown origin) by SPR method

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface Plasmon Resonance (Biacore) Analysis of Binding to BRD2, 3, and 4. Biacore data for His6-tagged BRD2 (1–473), BRD3 (1–434), and BRD4 (1–477) was acquired and analyzed on a T100 Biacore instrument at 25 °C. In all cases, a CM5 chip with ~5–12kU amine coupled protein immobilized on the dextran surface was used with a running buffer of 30 mM Heps pH 7, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM EGTA, Na3. Compounds were titrated as a tripling dilution starting from 10 μM. Sensorgrams and binding curves were analyzed with BIAevaluation (GE Healthcare) using a 1:1 binding model. The equilibrium K_D was calculated using response = concentration × R_max/(concentration + K_D) + offset. Example dose response fits are given in Supporting Information, Figure S2.
original_paragraph.Supporting Information: Isothermal Titration Calorimetry. ITC titration of BRD4 was carried out using a Microcal VP-ITC200 in 50 mM Heps, pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl, at 25 °C. First, 9 μM His-tagged BRD4 (1–477) tandem bromodomain was placed in the cell and 200 μM ligand was titrated into this to achieve a final ligand:protein excess of ~4:1. The data was then fitted within Origin (Microcal version) to give the following parameters: stoichiometry of 1.93, K_D of 4.4 ± 0.9 nM, ΔH −15.9 ± 0.08 kcal/mol, ΔS −15.2 cal/mol/deg.
